friction: First call timed out at 120s; succeeded on second attempt with the same args (same timeout). The `for_bars` parameter enforces 'for a while' but there is no signal-level minimum-hold detail returned — only the fire date is shown, so actual duration cannot be read from the output. Result set is dominated by mutual funds/ETFs rather than individual equities; an `asset_type: ['Common Stock']` filter would narrow to pure equities.
